environment_lock.summary: Nyx's own small apartment bedroom at night -- identical anchor set across all 3 parts of this story for visual continuity.

anchors.description: a small, intimate, lived-in one-person apartment bedroom; the bed takes up a substantial share of the floor space
deep forest-green bedding with one large matching pillow
a small warm reading lamp on a dark bedside table -- the main light source at night
an open wardrobe/closet with a low shelf, visible along one wall, with folded clothes and a few storage boxes
a desk with a monitor, set behind/near the bed area in the same small room
trailing green plants around the desk and the wall above it
a shelf of paperbacks and small trinkets, and a short string of warm fairy lights along the wall
a night window with ordinary city buildings visible outside
cozy, ordinary and slightly cluttered -- a real person's bedroom, not a styled set
